say:0:1013701001:0.text: I see the Sun Temple! Looks like we're on the right track!
say:0:1013701001:0.source_cn: 从地下通道出来后，确实能看到日神殿的轮廓了，看来没走错路！

say:1:1013701002:0.text: Aha, what would you do without a trusty guide like me!
say:1:1013701002:0.source_cn: 也不看看你们的向导是谁。

say:2:1013701003:0.text: You weren't even the one who discovered the secret passage!
say:2:1013701003:0.source_cn: 可我记得找到井底通道的并不是阿塔兰忒，而是主人！
say:2:1013701003:0.male: You weren't even the one who discovered the secret passage!
say:2:1013701003:0.female: You weren't even the one who discovered the secret passage!
